_leia: Os quadros do modo história (docs/historia.md §7): uma arte por desenho descrito no roteiro, sem texto. As falas entram por cima, em balões, a partir de docs/historia_piadas.json (só as aprovadas vão para o jogo); um quadro sem desenho próprio reusa a arte do anterior com outro plano ('perto', 'detalhe'), como no gibi. Gere com: python3 tools/historia/quadros.py [ids...] [--seco] [--qualidade medium] [--refazer]. Monte as páginas para revisar com: python3 tools/historia/quadros.py paginas [SAIDA.html]. Textos em inglês porque o gerador entende melhor; os letreiros dentro da cena (o caderno, o mural, as lombadas) vão em português, escritos como no roteiro.
estilo: A single comic-book panel from the cozy story mode of the game Dice Duel. It must look like the game's own art, the attached character art: a flat sticker illustration with a thick uniform dark cocoa outline (#3a2a2e) around every shape, flat color fills with ONE soft cel-shaded shadow tone and one small highlight, no gradients, no glow, no painterly texture, no realistic lighting, no 3D rendering. Only the game's palette: cream paper #fbf1df and #f1dfc2, ivory #fffaf0, sage felt greens #4e7d68 and #5f8f78, wood browns #7a4b2f and #a86c45, honey #f2b15e, coral #e8806f, rose #ec8fa8, sky blue #6fbfd3, lavender #b8a4f0, mint #8fd6a8, cocoa #3a2a2e. Backgrounds are SIMPLE: a few big flat color shapes (a wall, a floor, a window) with at most three props, no clutter, no decorative plants or mugs unless the scene asks for them. Cozy, adult, dry humor; expressive faces, not chibi, not childish. No halftone dots (they are added later), no panel border, no frame, no gutter, no white margin: the art fills the image edge to edge. No speech balloons, no captions, no sound effects and no lettering, except a sign the scene explicitly asks for. Every die is a plain six-sided cube with round pips, in its owner's color (Diana's are pink). Draw few dice, and every visible face with a correct standard pip layout: 1 = one center pip; 2 = two pips on a diagonal; 3 = three pips on a diagonal; 4 = four corners; 5 = four corners and the center; 6 = two parallel rows of three. Never more than six pips on a face, never a blank face, and two faces of the same die never show numbers that add up to 7.
referencia: The attached images are the official character portraits: keep each character's design, colors, markings and accessories exactly as in their portrait (the portraits only show the head; draw the rest of the body to match). Ignore any badge, medallion or hexagon frame around a portrait: it is not part of the character.

personagens.diana: DIANA: a white domestic cat with cool white fur (not cream, not yellow), clear light-blue eyes; the upper third of the ear on the VIEWER'S LEFT is solid black, the other ear is all white with pink inside; exactly TWO short vertical charcoal-gray stripes in the middle of her forehead; faint light-gray shading above the eyes; small pink nose, white whiskers. She has real cat proportions (four paws, no clothes); only her expressions are human: dry, confident, a little conspiratorial.
personagens.sapo: SAPO: an anthropomorphic green frog in a straw boater hat with a rust ribbon and a small rust bow tie; a slow, polite gentleman of the pond.
personagens.coelho: COELHO: an anthropomorphic light-gray rabbit (cool pale gray, not beige) with long ears and pink inner ears, wearing a navy bow tie; an anxious accountant, always late.
personagens.raposa: RAPOSA: an anthropomorphic red fox with half-closed contented eyes and a dark-green knitted scarf; elegant and pleased with herself.
personagens.urso: URSO: an anthropomorphic brown bear in a red knitted beanie with a cream pompom and cream rim; very sleepy.
personagens.guaxinim: GUAXINIM: an anthropomorphic raccoon with the black eye mask, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie; a relaxed thief with an economic theory.
personagens.ovelha: OVELHA: a sheep with fluffy cream wool and a brown face; tired of always being asked the same question.
personagens.coruja: DONA CORUJA: an old, wise brown tawny owl lady with large round amber eyes behind thin round reading glasses, small ear tufts and a pale cream chest with feather chevrons; a librarian. No mouth line under the beak.

Her face behind it, eyes half closed, unbothered, looking at the reader, not at the die.

nariz_modelo._leia: A folha de modelo do nariz: o retrato aprovado da Diana com cada enfeite, desenhado uma vez só, sempre no mesmo lugar, tamanho e ângulo. Cada quadro da Diana manda a folha do enfeite dele como referência (arte/historia/narizes/<id>.png), em vez do retrato puro.
nariz_modelo.regra: Edit the attached approved portrait of Diana the white cat. Keep EVERYTHING identical: same head, pose, framing, eyes, ear markings (black tip only on the ear on the viewer's left), the two vertical forehead stripes, outline weight, colors and flat sticker style. Plain flat cream background (#fbf1df). Change only the bridge of her nose, as described below. Every nose accessory in this series follows ONE pattern: it sits exactly on the flat bridge of the nose, centered between the eyes and above the pink nose pad, covering the spot of the small red diagonal scratch, tilted along the same diagonal as the scratch (from upper left to lower right), about as wide as the gap between her eyes, never bigger. It is a real little physical object stuck there (as if really taken from somewhere), drawn in the same flat style with the thick cocoa outline, one shadow tone and one small highlight, casting only a tiny contact shadow on the fur.

itens.ferida: No accessory: the small diagonal red scratch on the bridge of the nose is plainly visible, as in the portrait.
itens.pips: One small cream fabric adhesive bandage, rounded ends, printed with tiny dark dice pips (like the face of a die).
itens.x: Two small cream fabric adhesive bandages crossed in an X over the spot, the same bandage type as a plain first-aid strip.
itens.adesivo: One small cream fabric adhesive bandage, and stuck on its middle a tiny round coral sticker with a white question mark crossed out by a line.
itens.cachecol: A tiny strip of dark-green ribbed knitted scarf fabric (the same knit and green as the Fox's scarf), a flat band wrapped once over the bridge of the nose like a bandage, lying flat on the fur along the diagonal; its two little fringed ends hang loose on one side, next to her cheek. It must read clearly as a knitted scarf, not a hat.
itens.cone: NO bandage and nothing stuck on the nose: only the small diagonal red scratch, plainly visible. Around her neck, a large translucent plastic veterinary cone (Elizabethan collar) opening toward the viewer and framing her face.
itens.meia: A tiny striped sock (cream with coral and sky-blue stripes) folded and knotted over the bridge like a bandage.
itens.la: A fluffy tuft of cream-white sheep wool, real curly fleece with loose fibers, stuck on the bridge as if it had just been pulled from a sheep. The tuft is a little bigger than the other accessories: it covers the whole bridge between the eyes and puffs out slightly.
itens.nada: No accessory: the small diagonal red scratch on the bridge of the nose is plainly visible and a little raw, slightly pinker around it.
itens.curada: No accessory and no scratch: the bridge of the nose is healed, clean white fur with only a very faint thin pink line where the scratch was.

edicao.cachecol: Edit the attached image. Keep EVERYTHING identical (the cat, the face, the ears, the stripes, the eyes, the colors, the outline, the cream background) and keep the same little dark-green knitted scarf on her nose, the same knit and the same green. Change only its size and how it sits: make it a little bigger, resting ON TOP of the bridge of the nose like a small saddle, with its two sides falling down on each side of the nose toward the cheeks, each side ending in a short fringe. Draw the rest of her body as a real white cat with the same flat style.

pagina._leia: As páginas do caderno de receitas: uma página base (pagina-base) e cada receita desenhada nela, chapada, na tinta e aquarela do caderno. O título, os ingredientes e as notas da Diana são escritos pelo código, em letra de mão.
pagina.base: One page of Diana's old recipe notebook, seen perfectly straight from above, filling the whole image edge to edge (no table, no background around it, no shadow). Warm cream paper (#fbf1df) with faint sky-blue ruled lines, a thin coral margin line on the left, a ragged torn edge along the left side where it was ripped out, a small coffee ring stain near a corner. Flat, illustrated in the game's flat style (cocoa outline only on the torn edge), no lettering, no drawings: a blank page.
pagina.desenho: Edit the attached blank notebook page: keep the page itself identical (paper, ruled lines, margin, torn edge, stain, framing). Add one drawing DRAWN ON THE PAPER by hand, in dark cocoa ink line with flat watercolor washes in the game's palette, like an illustration sketched in the notebook: completely flat on the page, no shadow, no volume, no 3D object sitting on the paper, the ruled lines faintly visible through the wash. The drawing sits in the middle of the page; leave the top quarter and the bottom quarter of the page blank (handwriting is added there later). No lettering. THE DRAWING:

_balao: Cada arte com fala tem 'boca' (onde fica a boca de quem fala, em % da imagem: {quem: [x, y]}) e 'lugar' (o canto livre para o balão: nw, ne, sw, se). O rabinho do balão aponta para a boca, também nos planos 'perto' e 'detalhe'. Nos quadros: 'som' (onomatopeia), 'linhas' (movimento) e 'impacto' (quadro congelado com retícula forte e desencaixe azul e rosa). 'evitar': caixas (em % da imagem) que o balão não deve cobrir, como o letreiro da piada.
_mural: O mural é montado pelo código (tools/historia/paginas_modelo.html), não pintado: as fotos são os retratos que o jogo já tem (js/retratos_pintados.js), em polaroide, com barbante, post-its, cartões e carimbos. Assim ele é igual em todo quadro e cresce a cada capítulo. Coordenadas em % do quadro (3:2); 'fios' ligam os alfinetes pelos ids.
_refazer: Quando houver crédito na API, nesta ordem: (1) python3 tools/historia/quadros.py narizes cachecol; (2) python3 tools/historia/quadros.py --qualidade high p-pata i1-le c3-raposa c1-pag-a c6-ovelha (o c6-ovelha é uma edição da arte atual: só os hexágonos); (3) python3 tools/historia/dados_ia.py rascunhos, o dono escolhe nas pranchas e python3 tools/historia/dados_ia.py aplicar ...; (4) as artes novas do roteiro: f-empurra, c7-lacre, c7-tampa, c8-bolso; (5) os 6 antigos do piloto e o resto, no pedido novo.
_dados: Os dados dos quadros são conferidos depois de pintados: tools/historia/dados_quadros.py troca as bolinhas erradas pelas certas (anotações em 'dados' de cada arte).
